constraints.reason: Preserves the supplied lattice size and every requested coordinate while fixing the selected low-cost boundary prescription.
constraints.requirement: spatial_site_count must equal 5, lattice_spacing must equal 1, the authoritative site indices must be {-2,-1,0,1,2}, and the boundary condition must remain open

constraints.reason: The selected Wilson regulator retains both Dirac components at every site.
This fixed regulator reference supports the independently requested charge-zero level indices.
constraints.requirement: The lattice charge must be Q_lat=sum_{x,s} n_{x,s}-spatial_site_count, with no interacting-state-dependent subtraction.

constraints.applies_when: the selected open-boundary Wilson discretization is used
constraints.reason: Implements the Wilson regulator as the direct spatial second difference.
constraints.requirement: The onsite Wilson coefficient must be wilson_parameter/lattice_spacing at every retained site, including both endpoints; it must not be reduced according to endpoint coordination number.

constraints.reason: The continuum contract requires the unshifted Hamiltonian and places vacuum subtraction only in the requested matrix-element combination.
constraints.requirement: No additive vacuum-energy shift and no target-state expectation value may be inserted into the Hamiltonian or local interaction.

constraints.applies_when: constructing or evolving the ordered bilocal observable
constraints.requirement: Both Q_lat=0 and Q_lat=-1 sectors must be represented because the rightmost annihilation operator maps charge zero to charge minus one before the left insertion restores charge zero.

discretizations.scheme: centered one-dimensional spatial lattice with continuous real time

truncation.reason: Contains every requested coordinate while avoiding a Jordan-Wigner wrap-around hopping.

settings.endpoint_prescription: open Wilson second-difference with full onsite Wilson coefficient at every retained site

settings.optional_qubit_encoding: Jordan-Wigner in increasing site index and then spinor-component order
settings.wilson_second_derivative_prescription: onsite r/a at every site and hopping -r*beta/(2a) on every retained nearest-neighbor link

truncation.reason: Canonical fermion modes are exactly finite-dimensional; no occupation approximation is introduced.

validation_obligations.description: Confirm after construction that [H_lat,Q_lat]=0 exactly up to numerical representation tolerance.
Confirm that vacuum is level_index 0 and hadron is level_index 1 of the Q_lat=0 Hamiltonian block, without identifying the two states.
Confirm that every ordered observable insertion and real-time evolution is defined on the visited Q_lat=-1 intermediate sector and returns to Q_lat=0.
Confirm that z_index=0 is represented by the direct finite operator a^{-1} c_0^dagger (I-sigma_3) c_0 and that the interaction uses the direct finite S_x^2 operator.
Confirm that no link variables, Gauss-law constraints, gauge fixing, or gauge transporter are introduced for this non-gauge model.
